# spec03 — a self-declared GENERATED file gets chezmoi's `create_` attribute, and a census that says so

Reading `litellm` to decide whether it belongs under `home/` (spec02) turned up
a live defect that nobody had filed. It is small to fix and it generalises, so
it is its own unit.

## The defect, measured

`home/dot_config/litellm/config.yaml` shipped in `0b77a71` as a plain managed
file. Its own first line reads:

```
# GENERATED by scripts/gen-litellm-config.py — regenerate, don't hand-edit.
```

and `04-shell/10` R9 has `litellm-gen-config` **rewrite the deployed target**
at run time. A plain managed file is restored on every `chezmoi apply`, and
`rr` — `04-shell/02` R3 — is `chezmoi update --force`. Measured in a scratch
apply against a copy of the real `home/`:

| step | result |
|---|---|
| apply | `~/.config/litellm/config.yaml` deployed |
| regenerate the target | (what `llm gen` does) |
| `chezmoi status` | `MM .config/litellm/config.yaml` — permanent drift |
| apply again | **the regenerated routes are gone** |

So the user runs `llm gen` when a provider changes, and the next `rr` silently
throws the result away. This is the same class the shell-init epic already
settled — `05-platform/03` keeps its generated files out of the managed set —
with the direction reversed: here the *managed* file eats the *generated* one.

## The fix, also measured

chezmoi's `create_` attribute writes a target only when it is absent and never
overwrites it. Renaming the source to `create_config.yaml` — the attribute is
not part of the deployed name, which stays `~/.config/litellm/config.yaml` —
gives, in the same fixture:

| step | result |
|---|---|
| apply | deployed, and still in `chezmoi managed` |
| regenerate, then `chezmoi status` | **clean** |
| apply again | **the regeneration survives** |
| delete the target, apply | **re-created**, so a fresh machine still gets a baseline |

## Acceptance

- [x] `home/dot_config/litellm/config.yaml` is renamed to
      `create_config.yaml`, with `git mv` so the history follows. Content
      unchanged. — landed at `7efecaa`;
      `git log --name-status --diff-filter=R` gives
      `R100	home/dot_config/litellm/config.yaml	home/dot_config/litellm/create_config.yaml`
      — `R100` is the content-unchanged proof. `git status --porcelain
      home/dot_config/litellm` is empty.
- [x] `tests/shell-litellm.sh`'s `YAML=` follows the rename, and carries a
      comment saying `create_` is an attribute rather than part of the target
      name, and why it is load-bearing. — `tests/shell-litellm.sh:51`
      `YAML="$REPO/home/dot_config/litellm/create_config.yaml"`, under a
      comment naming R9 and `rr`.
- [x] `tests/managed-config.sh` gains a check: every file under `home/` whose
      first line declares it generated must carry the `create_` prefix. The
      predicate is the **file's own header**, not a hand-kept list, so it
      cannot go stale behind a rename. — check 7 in `stage_surface`
      (`tests/managed-config.sh:475-492`); the predicate greps
      `^#+ *GENERATED by ` and excludes basenames matching `create_*`.
- [x] That check is a factored predicate reporting the offending paths, and
      its FAIL line names them. — `generated_bare()` at
      `tests/managed-config.sh:244`, and the reporting is visible in the
      selftest's red direction: `(got: dot_config/litellm/plain.yaml)`.
- [x] Its comment records the measured before/after table above, not a
      reasoned claim. — it does, **and the table was re-measured on 2026-08-29
      by this pass** rather than carried on pass one's word. An isolated
      `chezmoi` (`env -i`, own `--source/--destination/--config/
      --persistent-state/--cache`) ran the same fixture against both source
      names, with the *same file content* in each:

      | step | `config.yaml` (as shipped) | `create_config.yaml` (the fix) |
      |---|---|---|
      | apply | `deployed=yes` | `deployed=yes` |
      | in `chezmoi managed` | yes (1 line) | yes (1 line) |
      | `status` after regenerating the target | `MM .config/litellm/config.yaml` | *(empty — clean)* |
      | apply again | **regeneration LOST** | **regeneration SURVIVED** |
      | delete the target, apply | `re-created=yes` | `re-created=yes` |

      Both halves of the analyst's table reproduce, including the one that
      matters for a fresh machine: `create_` still re-creates a deleted
      target.
- [x] `--selftest` plants a bare `GENERATED` file in a `scratch_tree` copy and
      the predicate reports it; renaming **the same file** to `create_*` —
      attribute added, content identical — reports nothing. That pairing is
      what proves the check is about the attribute rather than the filename.
      — `bash tests/managed-config.sh --selftest`, EXIT=0:
      `MUTATION: planted a bare GENERATED home/dot_config/litellm/plain.yaml` /
      `PASS  selftest red: a bare self-declared GENERATED file is reported (got: dot_config/litellm/plain.yaml)` /
      `MUTATION: renamed it to create_plain.yaml — attribute added, content identical` /
      `PASS  selftest green: the same file with create_ prepended is not reported`.
      The `mv` is a rename of the planted file, so content is identical by
      construction.
- [x] `--selftest` asserts the planted file was never created in the real tree.
      — `PASS  selftest: the real home/dot_local/share and litellm/plain.yaml were never created`.
- [x] `bash tests/shell-litellm.sh` and `bash tests/managed-config.sh` both
      exit 0. — `shell-litellm` `EXIT=0`, `── 41 passed, 0 failed ──`.
      `managed-config` `EXIT=0` / 67 PASS / 0 FAIL on a clean `HEAD` tree with
      this node's footprint overlaid; in the live working tree it is `EXIT=1`
      on `undeclared: tmux`, which is the concurrent session's untracked
      `home/dot_config/tmux/` and not this node's subject (see spec02's last
      box).
- [x] `bash tests/deploy-skeleton.sh` exits 0 — it walks `home/` and is the
      gate a source rename would break next. — `EXIT=0`, 63 PASS, ending
      `PASS — the deploy skeleton holds, and the live chezmoi config was never touched`.

## Verify and Proof

```sh
git status --porcelain home/dot_config/litellm
bash tests/shell-litellm.sh;   echo "EXIT=$?"
bash tests/managed-config.sh;  echo "EXIT=$?"
bash tests/deploy-skeleton.sh; echo "EXIT=$?"
bash tests/managed-config.sh 2>&1 | grep -E 'create_'
bash tests/managed-config.sh --selftest 2>&1 | grep -E 'GENERATED|create_'
```
